description: Open acoustic catalogs referenced by Starscream federation harvest. Rows are forked as metadata pointers (external_url) with license enforcement at ingest.

repos.name: Xeno-canto
repos.content: Field-recorded birds, bats, frogs, grasshoppers, soundscapes worldwide
repos.notes: API v3 requires tagged queries (grp:, cnt:, sp:, etc.) and per-member API key

repos.name: iNaturalist
repos.content: Research-grade biodiversity observations with geotagged sounds
repos.notes: Uses sound_license filter; NC stored pointer-only

repos.name: Freesound
repos.content: Community field recordings, urban, mechanical, nature (CC0/CC-BY subset)

repos.name: Internet Archive
repos.content: Field recordings, open audio, CC-licensed podcasts and radio
repos.notes: Separate harvest queries for nature/field vs CC podcasts

repos.name: NOAA PMEL Acoustics
repos.content: Marine mammal, fish, and ocean acoustic field recordings

repos.name: NASA Space Audio
repos.content: Planetary and spacecraft audio (Voyager, Mars, etc.)

repos.name: FSD50K
repos.content: 50k Freesound-derived clips for sound event detection
repos.notes: starscream-import fsd50k — local Zenodo extract required

repos.name: Macaulay Library (Cornell)
repos.notes: No public bulk API; link out via iNaturalist/Macaulay cross-refs when present

repos.name: GBIF
repos.content: Global biodiversity occurrence records (some with multimedia)
repos.notes: Future connector candidate; iNaturalist syndicates to GBIF

repos.name: Wikimedia Commons
repos.content: Nature and field recording audio files
